name: My Friend's Family
source:
Before joining the military, your friend asked you to live with his family. He wants you to protect his mother and sister while he's gone. Being unemployed due to COVID, you decided to accept his offer since you wouldn’t worry about rent payment anymore. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/captainkitty/about]Patreon[/url]]
